entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • first-run experience can impact the completions command in a way that breaks the command #50444
  • Broken Test output when specifying `-tl:off` in `Directory.Build.rsp` #50441
  • AOT publish doesn't work if PackAsTool is set (a regression) #50435

Closed

  • [dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-rc.1.25409.103] RoslynPad restore with error: NETSDK1226: Prune Package data not found .NETCoreApp 10.0 Microsoft.NETCore.App #50233
  • [NETE2ESDK][Regression]update workload to manifest mode failed with error "Version 9.0.10 of package microsoft.netcore.app.runtime.mono.android-arm.msi.x64 is not found..." #50430
  • AppendRuntimeIdentifierToOutputPath doesn't affect OutputPath for dotnet pack #50437
  • [NETE2ESDK][ARM64] x64 .NET 10 RC1 candidate SDK commands hang on ARM64 machines #50360

PullRequests

Created

  • Make packtool targets light up only on pack #50445
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 (#49531) #50443
    breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created
  • Update copilot-setup-steps.yml for MCP servers #50442
  • Add globalJson property for global.json state to toplevelparser/command event #50440
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50438
  • [release/10.0.1xx-rc1] [StaticWebAssets] Use property for original resource #50436
  • Remove directory option in dotnet test #50434
  • Set RoslynAssembliesPath #50433
  • Remove FileLoggersCount from MSBuild telemetry event #50432
  • Shutdown build servers via named pipes #50429
    Area-CLI
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50427

Merged

  • Add net11.0 known framework references #50329
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Support `dotnet pack file.cs` #50168
    Area-run-file
  • Run the man page script against the release branch so that GA gets the latest #50423
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50428
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2777507 #50424
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50371

Updated

  • Update ProcessFrameworkReferences and ResolveAppHosts to not look for runtime-specific assets for the `any` RID #50421
  • Prepare delta applier for code sharing #49974
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Update overlay SDK to include the stage0 downlevel implicit versions (#50344) #50418
  • [StaticWebAssets] Use property for original resource #50420
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add PostAction for dotnet.config #50285
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Use AnalysisMode=minimum in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers and fix errors (perf rules) #50367
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Avoid ConcurrentDictionary allocation in DisposeObjectsBeforeLosingScope #50309
  • CA1033 should not report errors for interfaces #50339
    Area-Infrastructure
  • CA1860 should be reported for derived types as well (analyzer fix with performance improvements) #50397
  • [release/10.0.1xx-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50403
  • Reduce allocations in EnumsShouldHaveZeroValueAnalyzer #50411
  • MSBuild Server dogfood (#12120) #50389
